title: Deposit prepaid funeral money in an approved trust
what: Deposit money received under a prepaid funeral agreement in an approved funeral trust within 14 days.

sources.title: Prepaid Funerals Act 2004 (Tas)
sources.quote: Within 14 days after receiving any money under a prepaid funeral agreement, a person carrying on the funeral business must deposit that money in a funeral trust approved by the Director
